Prevention: Remove, burn and bury crop residues from the previous cropping season.
Farmers should cultivate varieties which are flat and with tip covers.
Harvest when the cobs have attained physiological maturity.
Select sound/healthy cobs after harvesting for shelling.
Shell and sun-dry the grains on cemented floors, plastic sheets, mats or tarpaulins.
Winnow and remove all damaged grains before treatment.
Use modern granaries and mini silos with no cracks and built-in, isolated, well-ventilated areas to store grains.
Treat old storage bags with hot water (50-60°C) for 5 mins and allow them to dry before storing grain.
Treat the grain before storage - see yellow column.
Do not plant maize near the storage area.
Monitoring: Monitor cobs at maturity to ensure timely harvesting.
Monitor cobs for maize weevil infestation.
Look for holes in the grains - the females lay eggs inside the grain and the larva eat the inside of the grain.
The adult weevils are small and brown with a long narrow snout.
Monitor for the presence of a bad smell in storage caused by weevil feeding.
Weevils are known to produce sound when they are feeding, especially when their population is high.
Collect grain samples at random points and check for adult weevils or damage.
Treat produce when there are less than 5 weevils.
Record all treatments carried out on the stack card.
Direct Control: Use metallic silos, cemented silos, clay pots or drums for storage of grain.
Pirimiphos methyl: organophosphate, IRAC 1B; Permethrin: a pyrethroid
Restrictions: Use personal protective equipment when handling and applying pesticides, follow the label recommendations.
Do not eat, drink, smoke when mixing or applying pesticides.
Treat the grain soon after harvesting
and make sure it has dried sufficiently before storing in polypropylene or in sealed storage facilities
Dilute 200-400 ml in 5L water & apply 10 ml to 100 m2 of bag surface.
Loose grain: dilute 1 ml in 250ml of water and apply uniformly to 50kg of grain. 45 days treatment to consumption

Admix 25g/One box full with 50kg of shelled grain using a plate or shovel. 45 days treatment to consumption
